snippet.title: Farmer Fowl’s Farmhouse | Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Step inside the abandoned Farmer Fowl's Farmhouse — once a cheerful children's attraction, now left to rot since it's sudden closure decades prior. You play as Eli, a salvage assessor sent to document and mark the building's remaining assets before demolition. Armed with a flashlight, camera, and a stack of sticky notes. What begins as routine work quickly spirals into something...far darker. 


Wishlist the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4027120/Farmer_Fowls_Farmhouse/?beta=0
